frame: Module frame: origin at the outline centre; +x along the header row from pin 1 to the last pin (two-row modules: along the rows, pin 1 end at -x); +y from the header toward the module body (two-row modules: from the first-listed row to the second). Millimetres. 'front' is the face away from the carrier board.

features.name: USB-C receptacle
features.note: USB-C is at the pin-1 end; the case corridor is sized to the plug overmold, not the receptacle

features.name: PCB antenna end
features.note: no metal and no screws over the antenna end; plastic wall is fine

features.name: BOOT / RESET (on the module)
features.note: reached only to recover a board that will not flash; the case may cover them if the back opens

sources: BLOCK.md: supplier drawing pages 2-3, read 2026-09-28 (18.00 x 22.52 mm, rows 15.24 mm apart, USB at the pin-1 end)
assumptions: seatHeightMm 8.5 is a standard 2.54 mm female socket
antenna and BOOT/RESET positions are typical clone layout, not measured
